steps.player: You look ready for combat.

steps.npc: Aye, indeed I am.

steps.player: What brings you to this place? I can't imagine anyone coming here by choice.

steps.npc: You're right, I did not come here by choice. I came here for vengeance.

steps.player: Vengeance? Against whom? Did someone take your gardening equipment?

steps.npc: My mission is not against another man and I will not have it mocked.

steps.player: Okay, sorry, I was just trying to lighten the mood. Care to tell me what it is against then?

steps.npc: Callisto, the great bear of the wilderness.

steps.player: Can't say I've come across it before.

steps.npc: I'm not surprised, you'd do well to avoid him. Callisto is a great bear, his strength and size enhanced by the corruption of the Wilderness.

steps.text: With at least one Callisto kill:

steps.player: Ah, I've had a few run ins with him myself.

steps.npc: Then you'll know he's not something to mock. I'm surprised you survived your encounter with such a great and corrupted beast.

steps.player: I'm stronger than I look, I've seen my fair share of monsters.
Why are you so intent on taking him down?

steps.npc: Callisto killed my father. After hearing of a great beast in the heart of the Wilderness, he took it upon himself to bring him down.
He left our family home in Hosidius to hunt it down and...
... I haven't seen my father since. I swore I would avenge him and have dedicated my whole life to training for that moment.

steps.player: What happens after? When you do take Callisto down that is.

steps.npc: Oh... uh... I never thought about that...
My whole life has been spent preparing to avenge my father, I never thought about anything else...

steps.player: You seem like you've got a lot to think about then. I'll leave you to it.

options.condition: If the player has Craw's bow or the Fangs of Venenatis:

steps.text: With only Craw's bow in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the bow to Derse Venator.

steps.npc: Ah, a fellow marksman. That's a unique bow you have there.

steps.player: Do you know anything about it?

steps.npc: I've done my fair bit of fletching in my day. I'd say this bow can be improved upon.
See those etches on it? You could put something sharp in there to improve the bow's strength.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.

steps.text: With only the Fangs of Venenatis in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the Fangs of Venenatis to Derse Venator.

steps.npc: Those look like strong fangs. You could probably attach them to a bow to make it stronger.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a suitable bow.
Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the bow to Derse Venator.

steps.npc: Ah, a fellow marksman. That's a unique bow you have there.

steps.player: Do you know anything about it?

steps.npc: I've done my fair bit of fletching in my day. I'd say this bow can be improved upon.
See those etches on it? You could put something sharp in there to improve the bow's strength.

steps.player: Perhaps I could use this?

steps.text: You show the Fangs of Venenatis to Derse Venator.

steps.npc: Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.

steps.player: Could you combine them?

steps.npc: Sure I can. For the right price.

steps.player: Sigh. How much?

steps.npc: 500,000 coins would do nicely.

steps.prompt: Pay 500,000 coins to combine the fangs and bow?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have the money for that.

steps.npc: Feel free to come back when you do.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:
Derse Venator combines the items and gives you the Webweaver bow (u).

steps.npc: There we go! All done.

steps.player: No thanks.

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.text: You show the claws to Derse Venator.

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.player: Yeah. I got them from a really big bear.

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.npc: By the gods... This bear must be even bigger than I imagined.

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.player: So do you know if the claws would be useful at all?

using-items-on-him-claws-of-callisto.npc: I... have a lot to think about. Perhaps Andros Mai over there can help you while I think.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.text: You show the skull to Derse Venator.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: That looks like any skull to me. Who's is it?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: It's mine. I picked it up.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: I meant... Sigh. Never mind. What do you want with the skull?

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.player: I'm trying to find out if it's useful.

using-items-on-him-skull-of-vet-ion.npc: Don't know much about skulls, myself. That mage over there might know.
She's into some weird stuff, that one. Think she said her name was Phabelle Bile.

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.text: You show the weapon piece to Derse Venator.

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.player: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?

using-items-on-him-voidwaker-part.npc: Just earlier I saw this lady run down into the basement of this pub.
I don't know who she is, but she looks like a strange one.
Strange attracts strange, so I reckon she might know about your strange weapon piece.
